text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 5) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 24 Julai 2018.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan atau penggunaan kenderaan bermotor dan jentera bergerak yang

mempunyai berat tanpa muatan lima ribu kilogram dan lebih ("kenderaan berat"),

di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua, pada hari dan masa yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan ini diberikan bagi maksud dan hal keadaan yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya Larangan Terpakai

(2)

Hari dan Tarikh Larangan

Laluan 1, Jalan Butterworth - Sungai Petani

dari koordinat U 5.38721, T 100.388117

hingga koordinat U 5.399391, T 100.374291

Tiap-tiap hari

(kecuali hari kelepasan am)

Pagi: 6.30 pagi hingga 8.30 pagi

Petang: 5.00 petang hingga 7.00 petang

JADUAL KEDUA

JADUAL KETIGA

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan dan

pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan atau

pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda di dalam,

pada, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud diangkut di atas kenderaan selain kenderaan berat.

4. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi

Kerajaan dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

5. Bagi maksud pemeriksaan, pembuangan dan penghantaran sisa domestik oleh

kenderaan berat seperti lori sampah, lori pembersihan pembentungan dan

lori vakum pembentungan.

6. Jika disebabkan sesuatu kecemasan, termasuk banjir, penggunaan mana-mana

jalan (yang bukannya bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama) oleh sesuatu kenderaan berat menjadi mustahil atau tidak

sesuai, Pegawai yang Menjaga Daerah Polis yang berkenaan boleh, setakat

sebagaimana yang difikirkannya perlu, membenarkan kenderaan berat itu

untuk menggunakan bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual

Pertama sebagai jalan alternatif bagi tempoh yang dalamnya penggunaan jalan

(yang bukannya bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual

Pertama) oleh kenderaan berat itu berterusan menjadi mustahil atau tidak

sesuai.

Dibuat 23 Julai 2018

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/15 Jld.5; PN(PU2)460/CXV]

BARU BIAN

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 5) ORDER 2018

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 367/2018 published on 9 July 2018, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against the

making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport

(Prohibition of Use of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 5) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 24 July 2018.

Prohibition

2. The driving or use of motor vehicles and mobile machineries with unladen

weight of five thousand kilogrammes and more ("heavy vehicles"), on the part of the

road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second

Schedule, on the day and time specified in column (2) of the First Schedule is prohibited.

Exemption

3. An exemption from the provision is given for the purposes and circumstances

specified in the Third Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road to which Prohibition Applies

(2)

Day and Time of Prohibition

Part of Route 1, Jalan Butterworth – Sungai

Petani from coordinates N 5.38721,

E 100.388117 to coordinates

N 5.399391, E 100.374291

Every day

(except public holidays)

Morning: 6.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.

Evening: 5.00 p.m. to 7.00 p.m.

SECOND SCHEDULE

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance of

the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal of

any structure, works, apparatus or any thing in, on, under or over the part of the

road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of being transported on a vehicle other than heavy vehicles.

4. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the Government

agencies and local authorities.

5. For the purposes of checking, disposal and delivery of domestic waste by

heavy vehicles such as garbage truck, sewerage cleaning truck and

sewerage vacuum truck.

6. Where by reason of an emergency, including flood, the use of any road

(not being part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule) by a

heavy vehicle is rendered impossible or unsuitable, the relevant Officer in charge

of the Police District may, in so far as he considers necessary, allow the heavy

vehicle to use the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as

an alternative road for the period during which the use of the road (not being

part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule) by the heavy

vehicle continues to be impossible or unsuitable.

Made 23 July 2018

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/15 Jld.5; PN(PU2)460/CXV]

BARU BIAN

Minister of Works
